headline: Eight lights on.
voice: It's eight in the evening. Upstairs and downstairs, light spills from every window.

headline: The last ones out.
voice: The family heads out. The front door closes behind them. All eight lights stay on.

headline: An empty house. A running bill.
voice: Eight sixty-watt lamps, left on for eight hours, use three point eight four kilowatt-hours. At twenty-five euro cents per kilowatt-hour, that's ninety-six cents to light an empty house.

headline: Same night. Lights off.
voice: Let's replay that night. The last person out switches off the lights. Over the same eight hours, those lamps add zero to the bill.

headline: Light the room you need.
voice: Someone comes home. One room lights up. Your API can work the same way.

headline: One call wakes your API.
voice: With SlimFaas, an idle API can scale to zero. The next HTTP call wakes a worker and waits for its answer.

headline: Queue the burst.
detail: Workers join as the queue grows.
voice: Watch this real deployment. Thirty calculations arrived together. Four workers shared the load.

headline: Give the capacity back.
detail: The last worker shuts down after the idle timeout.
voice: All thirty finished. After the idle timeout, the worker count returned to zero.

headline: lower infrastructure costs
voice: At Devoxx Belgium, one team reported cutting its infrastructure costs by more than sixty percent.

headline: Try it with one HTTP endpoint.
voice: Try SlimFaas locally with one of your own HTTP endpoints.
